description: MoltEvo skill A/B and learning-curve suite (deterministic graders).

commit-style.description: Commit message convention for this repository
commit-style.instructions: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits with a scope: `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`, e.g. `feat(calc): add sub`. Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore.

answer-style.description: How to format explanations of code
answer-style.instructions: When explaining code, always end the answer with a final line that starts with `TL;DR:` followed by a one-sentence summary.

python-docstrings.description: Docstring rules for new Python functions
python-docstrings.instructions: Every new Python function must have a Google-style docstring with an `Args:` section and a `Returns:` section.

license-header.description: License header for new source files
license-header.when_to_use: creating a new Python file or module
license-header.instructions: Every new Python file must start with the exact first line `# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`.

run-tests.description: How to run this project's tests
run-tests.instructions: This project uses a src/ layout. Run tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q`; plain `pytest` fails with ImportError.

project-layout.when_to_use: adding a new module or Python file
project-layout.instructions: All application modules live under `src/app/`. Never create Python modules in the repository root.

logging-convention.description: How to report problems in application code
logging-convention.instructions: Report problems with the project logger: `from app.log import log`, then `log.error(...)` or `log.warning(...)`. Never use print() for diagnostics.

changelog-policy.instructions: Every code change must add a bullet under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md describing the change.

gen-script.instructions: tools/gen.py only works with the environment variable GEN_MODE=fast, e.g. `GEN_MODE=fast python tools/gen.py`. Without it, it fails with an unhelpful error.

timezone-tests.instructions: The test suite must be run with TZ=UTC, e.g. `TZ=UTC python -m pytest -q`.

slow-tests.instructions: Some tests are marked slow and take minutes. Run the suite with `python -m pytest -q -m 'not slow'`.

app-entry.instructions: Run the app as a module: `python -m app`. Running app/__main__.py directly fails with an import error.
